uncited: Improved APMGSRN builds on [Adaptive Feature Grids](10458-adaptive-feature-grids.md) by optimizing the storage and retrieval of the learned feature grids.
*   **Feature Grids:** Multi-level hash grids storing learnable vectors at vertices.
*   **Compressed Weights:** The output of the SZ3 compression algorithm applied to the regularized grids.
**Generate Feature Grids:** Train the APMGSRN model to produce regularized feature grids for the target volume data.
The hyperparameters for APMGSRN are configurable to balance performance and storage.
